messages.text: Hi Jordan, confirming from our security review call: we need SAML through Okta as our identity provider, live by December 15. This is a hard requirement for our InfoSec sign-off, not a nice-to-have. We also need SCIM provisioning — that's required too, so our IT team can automate user lifecycle through Okta instead of managing accounts manually. Let me know once you have a committed date.
Thanks Dana, got it — SAML/Okta and SCIM, targeting Dec 15. Looping in our product team this week.
